PoH state machine, reset, hashing, tick, and microblock publish logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the `fd_poh` state machine for Proof of History timing and slot progression. It defines the shared-memory object lifecycle with `fd_poh_new()` and `fd_poh_join()`, then manages reset, leader start, leader completion, and hash advance logic. The code tracks the current slot, hash count, tick rate, leader slot, and microblock limits, and it uses these values to move between states such as `STATE_UNINIT`, `STATE_FOLLOWER`, `STATE_WAITING_FOR_BANK`, `STATE_WAITING_FOR_SLOT`, `STATE_LEADER`, and `STATE_WAITING_FOR_RESET`.

The file also publishes PoH events to other tiles through `fd_stem_publish()`. It sends tick records, skipped tick records, leader completion messages, and microblocks with transaction payloads. The functions `fd_poh_advance()`, `fd_poh1_mixin()`, and `publish_tick()` contain the main timing and hashing logic. They keep the PoH hash chain in sync with wall-clock time, enforce tick and microblock rules, and notify replay and shredder stages when a slot ends or when a leader slot produces output.
